augmentation_policy: Outside deterministic preprocessing; propose later as a training-stage decision only.

foreground_definition_analysis.combined_or_label_bounding_box: Rejected for deterministic baseline preprocessing because it depends on manual labels unless reproduced from MRI alone.
foreground_definition_analysis.manual_segmentation_foreground_mask: Useful for training audit/sampling labels only; rejected as inference-time crop requirement.
foreground_definition_analysis.nonzero_mri_mask: Available at inference and suitable for nonzero normalization/candidate MRI-derived crop.

invariant_scientific_checks: output MRI and label shapes match
no validation/test information influences fitted training parameters

label_mapping_contract.prediction_to_source: Map contiguous predictions back to original DKT IDs for evaluation and visualization.
label_mapping_contract.source_to_training: Map original DKT IDs to contiguous classes 0-62 during tensor creation.
label_mapping_contract.unknown_id_policy: Fail immediately; never silently map unknown IDs.

local_compute_feasibility.cpu_validation: Feasible for read-only loading, normalization smoke tests, label remapping tests and small-batch preprocessing validation.
local_compute_feasibility.known_environment: Windows 11, Intel i7-1165G7, about 31.7 GiB RAM, no NVIDIA GPU detected, PyTorch/MONAI/nnU-Net not installed.
local_compute_feasibility.training: Practical 3D training likely requires GPU access; local CPU can support reduced-model experiments only.

loss_design_recommendation.class_weighting: Defer class-weighted cross-entropy until a baseline demonstrates need; class frequencies are recorded from training labels only.

normalization_options_compared.assessment: Simple and leakage-safe but leaves extreme bright tails untouched.
Recommended conservative baseline; clipping percentiles are fixed in this proposal and justified from training audit.
Possible but less robust to per-scan intensity scale variation; requires persisted train-only fitted parameters.

normalization_recommendation.fit_scope: per volume independently using MRI nonzero voxels only
normalization_recommendation.rationale: Reproducible for unseen images, uses MRI intensities only, avoids validation/test-derived global fitted parameters, and limits extreme tails before z-scoring.
normalization_recommendation.validation_test_use: descriptive audit only; no fitted global parameters derived from validation/test

input: accepted matching manual DKT31 label path

sampling_policy_recommendation.leakage_note: Training labels may guide training patch sampling, but validation/test preprocessing and inference must not require labels. Sampling policy must be disabled for deterministic validation/test full-volume or sliding-window inference.

spatial_strategy_recommendation.crop_policy: No label-derived crop for baseline deterministic preprocessing. MRI-derived crop/pad may be revisited if implemented reversibly and reproducibly for unseen MRI.
spatial_strategy_recommendation.rationale: Better anatomical context than 64^3 with materially lower logits/activation memory than 128^3; full-volume geometry remains reconstructable.

storage_estimates.compressed_storage_note: NIfTI gzip/NPZ/Zarr compression depends on values and chunking; source .nii.gz files are already compressed.
